name: lpn_sero
description: L. pneumophila serogroup 1-15 LPS locus typing (Nakaue 2021)
license: Public domain (INSDC/DDBJ sequences); paper copyright ASM, cited only
note: 16 LPS biosynthetic loci (lpg0745-lpg0779 span) of L. pneumophila serogroups 1-15 (Nakaue 2021, doi:10.1128/JCM.00157-21, INSDC accessions), plus Lens NC_006369 as a second SG1 reference; 13 cluster_match rules. SG3/15 and SG6/12 are sequence-identical complexes. Bundled snapshot of the local build; regenerated from the same INSDC sources.

references.citation: Nakaue R, Qin T, Morita M, et al. Development of a Multiplex-PCR Serotyping Assay for Characterizing Legionella pneumophila Serogroups Based on the Diversity of Lipopolysaccharide Biosynthetic Loci. J Clin Microbiol 2021;59:e00157-21.

caveats: SG3/15 and SG6/12 are sequence-identical LPS complexes - reported as complexes, never resolved to single serogroups
130b-like strains (IS-disrupted LPS locus) fall below coverage floors and report untypeable with best-locus evidence
